title: CPI launches padayatra in Visakhapatnam under ‘Modi Hatao, Desh Bachao’ campaign
description: J.V. Satyanarayana Murthy said the nationwide campaign began on August 6 and would end in a rally at Ramlila Maidan on September 1, and asked Deputy Chief Minister Pawan Kalyan to clarify his stand on the environmental effects of the proposed data centres
